# Environment Setup

```{r setup}
# Packages
library(rprojroot)
library(tidyverse)
library(pomp)
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)
library(doRNG)
library(patchwork)
library(GGally)
library(lubridate)
library(formattable)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(htmltools)

# Set Random Seed
nb_name <-  "Cholera modelling with compartmental models and pomp - no disaster, new data"
seed <- sum(sapply(str_split(nb_name, pattern = "", simplify = TRUE), FUN = utf8ToInt))

# Parallel Computing
n_cores <- parallel::detectCores()
registerDoParallel(n_cores)
registerDoRNG(seed)

# Folder Structure
root <- has_file("cholera-surveillance.Rproj")$make_fix_file()
raw_data_dir <- root("data/raw")
proc_data_dir <- root("data/processed")
output_models_dir <- root("models_output/models")
dir.create(output_models_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
output_params_dir <- root("models_output/parameters")
dir.create(output_params_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
img_dir <- root("images")
dir.create(img_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
src_dir <- root("src")

# Local Packages
model_builder <- new.env()
source(file.path(src_dir, "model_builder_new_vacc_2.R"), local=model_builder)
global_searches <- new.env()
source(file.path(src_dir, "run_global_searches.R"), local=global_searches)
NegBin <- new.env()
source(file.path(src_dir, "optimize_arnb.R"), local=NegBin)
viz <- new.env()
source(file.path(src_dir, "viz.R"), local=viz)
```

# Functions

```{r}
symlog <- function(x) {
  symlogx <- list()
  for (i in 1:length(x)) {
    if (is.na(x[i])) {
      symlogx[i] <- NA
    }
    else if (abs(x[i]) < 1e-5) {
      symlogx[i] <- x[i]
    }
    else if (x[i] > 0) {
      symlogx[i] <- log(x[i])
    }
    else {
      symlogx[i] <- -log(-x[i])
    }
  }
  return(symlogx)
}

custom_color_tile <- function(...) {
  formatter("span",
    style = function(x) style(
      display = "block",
      padding = "0 4px",
      "border-radius" = "4px",
      "background-color" = csscolor(gradient(log(as.numeric(x) - min(as.numeric(x)) + 1), ...))))
}

custom_color_bar <- function(color = "lightblue", min_width = 30, fun = "proportion", ...) {
  fun <- match.fun(fun)
  formatter("span",
    style = function(x) style(
      display = "inline-block",
      direction = "rtl",
      "unicode-bidi" = "plaintext",
      "border-radius" = "4px",
      "padding-right" = "2px",
      "background-color" = csscolor(color),
      width = percent(fun(as.numeric(x) - min(as.numeric(x)) + min_width, ...))
    ))
}


normalize <- function(x) {
  (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x))
}
```

# Computational Parameters

```{r}
reset_data <- TRUE
run_level <- 2
Np <- switch(run_level, 100, 1e3, 5e3)
Nmif <- switch(run_level, 20, 100, 200)
Nreps <- switch(run_level, 10, 20, 100)
Nreps_eval <- switch(run_level, 2, 10, 20)
Nsim <- switch(run_level, 50, 100, 500)
profile_pts <- switch(run_level, 3, 5, 30)
profile_Nreps <- switch(run_level, 2, 3, 10)
```

# Parameters

From: https://databank.worldbank.org/reports.aspx?source=2&series=SP.DYN.CBRT.IN&country= Birth and death rates are per person and per DAY (all rates in the model are daily rates). Note that one unit of time is one year and each time step is 1/52 so all times and rates need to be scaled to this. For example, an infectious period of 10 days needs to be expressed as the number of units (1/52): (10/7) \* (1/52). For the same reason birth and death rates that are collected as rate per year they only need to be scaled by the number of people but left as year estimates. The time step 1/52 is then applied during the pomp step.

```{r}
custom_colors = c(

# Birth and death rates
# From: https://databank.worldbank.org/reports.aspx?source=2&series=SP.DYN.CBRT.IN&country=

df_dem <- tibble(
  date = df_reports$date[seq(1, length(df_reports$date), length.out=10)],
  deathrate = c(10.1, 9.9, 9.6, 9.4, 9.5, 9.7, 9.4, 9.4, 9.4, 9.4) / (1000),
  birthrate = c(43.5, 43.4, 43, 42.7, 42.3, 42, 41.7, 41.3, 41, 40.7) * 1.05 / (1000) # rates are adjusted to better reflect data that Andrew shared
)
```

# Full model data

```{r}
df_full <- (
  df_reports
  %>% merge(
    df_dem,
    by="date",
    all.x=TRUE
  )
  %>% mutate(
    date = seq(-1, n()-2, by = 1) / 52,
    birthrate = zoo::na.approx(birthrate, na.rm=FALSE),  # We interpolated the rates
    deathrate = zoo::na.approx(deathrate, na.rm=FALSE)
  )
)
```

## Global Search

### Search Parameters

#### Search Steps

```{r}
rw.sd_rp <- 0.02
rw.sd_ivp <- 0.2
rw.sd_b <- rw_sd(
  s_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  e_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  a_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  i_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  r_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  Beta = rw.sd_rp,
  b_seas_1 = rw.sd_rp,
  b_seas_2 = rw.sd_rp,
  b_seas_3 = rw.sd_rp,
  b_seas_4 = rw.sd_rp,
  b_seas_5 = rw.sd_rp,
  b_seas_6 = rw.sd_rp,
  eps_A = rw.sd_rp,
  f_ai = rw.sd_rp,
  mu_rs = rw.sd_rp,
  tau = rw.sd_rp,
  rho = rw.sd_rp,
  sigmaSE = rw.sd_rp
)
```

#### Search Box

```{r}
s_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
e_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
a_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
i_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
r_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
Beta_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1, max = 1000)
b_seas_1_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1E-3, max = 1E3)
b_seas_2_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1E-3, max = 1E3)
b_seas_3_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1E-3, max = 1E3)
b_seas_4_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1E-3, max = 1E3)
b_seas_5_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1E-3, max = 1E3)
b_seas_6_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1E-3, max = 1E3)
eps_A_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
f_ai_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
mu_rs_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1e-3, max = 300) 
tau_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 5)
rho_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
sigmaSE_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.001, max = 0.4)


guess_points_b <- as.data.frame(cbind(
  s_0 = s_0_guesses,
  e_0 = e_0_guesses,
  a_0 = a_0_guesses,
  i_0 = i_0_guesses,
  r_0 = r_0_guesses,
  Beta = Beta_guesses,
  b_seas_1 = b_seas_1_guesses,
  b_seas_2 = b_seas_2_guesses,
  b_seas_3 = b_seas_3_guesses,
  b_seas_4 = b_seas_4_guesses,
  b_seas_5 = b_seas_5_guesses,
  b_seas_6 = b_seas_6_guesses,
  eps_A = eps_A_guesses,
  f_ai = f_ai_guesses,
  mu_rs = mu_rs_guesses,
  tau = tau_guesses,
  rho = rho_guesses,
  sigmaSE = sigmaSE_guesses
))
```

### Run model

```{r}
model_params <- coef(m_b)
fixed_params <- model_params[!(names(model_params) %in% names(guess_points_b))]

stew(
  file = output_model_name_b, 
  dir = output_models_dir,
  expr = {
    start <- Sys.time()
    m_global_b <- foreach (guess=iter(guess_points_b, "row"), .combine=c) %dopar% {
      (
        m_b
        %>% mif2(
          Np=Np,
          Nmif=Nmif,
          params=c(fixed_params, unlist(guess)),
          cooling.fraction.50 = 0.5,
          rw.sd = rw.sd_b
        )
        %>% mif2(cooling.fraction.50 = 0.1)
      )
    }
    loglik_global_b <- (
      foreach(
        i=1:Nreps,
        .combine=rbind
      ) %dopar% {
        logmeanexp(
          replicate(
            Nreps_eval,
            logLik(pfilter(m_b, params=coef(m_global_b[[i]]), Np=1000))
          ),
          se=TRUE
        )
      }
    )
    end <- Sys.time()
    cat("Run time of global iterated particle filter: ", as.integer(round(difftime(end, start, units='mins'))), " minutes")
  }
)
```

### Collect and Save Results

```{r}
df_results_b <- global_searches$collect_and_save_loglik(
  model_search = m_global_b,
  loglik_values = loglik_global_b,
  out_filename = output_params_path_b,
  reset_data = reset_data
)
```

### Diagnostic

#### Summary

```{r}
coef(m_global_b[[which.max(loglik_global_b[,1])]])
```



```{r}
  global_searches$simulate_best_model(

    nsim = Nsim
  )
  %>% mutate(
    date = df_reports$date[1] + weeks(round(date * 52))
  )
```

# With Covariate Modulation

## Search Parameters

### Search Steps

```{r}
# Parameters 
rw.sd_rp <- 0.02
rw.sd_ivp <- 0.2
cooling.fraction.50 <- 0.5 # Level of parameter variance after 50% of iterations
rw.sd <- rw_sd(
  s_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  e_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  a_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  i_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  r_0 = ivp(rw.sd_ivp),
  b_cov = rw.sd_rp,
  eps_A = rw.sd_rp,
  f_ai = rw.sd_rp,
  mu_rs = rw.sd_rp,
  tau = rw.sd_rp,
  rho = rw.sd_rp,
  sigmaSE = rw.sd_rp
)
```

### Search Box

```{r}
sigmaSE_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.003, max = 0.2)
s_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
e_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
a_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
i_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
r_0_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
b_cov_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 2, max = 2000)
eps_A_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
f_ai_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
mu_rs_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1e-3, max = 300)
rho_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 0.01, max = 0.99)
tau_guesses <- runif(Nreps, min = 1e-4, max = 5)

guess_points <- as.data.frame(cbind(
  sigmaSE = sigmaSE_guesses,
  s_0 = s_0_guesses,
  e_0 = e_0_guesses,
  a_0 = a_0_guesses,
  i_0 = i_0_guesses,
  r_0 = r_0_guesses,
  b_cov = b_cov_guesses,
  eps_A = eps_A_guesses,
  f_ai = f_ai_guesses,
  mu_rs = mu_rs_guesses,
  tau = tau_guesses,
  rho = rho_guesses
))
```


### Model Definition

```{r}
m_1 <- model_builder$build_pomp_model(
  data = df_full,
  use_cov = TRUE,
  use_cov_intercept = FALSE,
  shift_cov = TRUE,
  n_shift_cov = 1
)
```

### Global Search

```{r}
model_params <- coef(m_1)
fixed_params <- model_params[!(names(model_params) %in% names(guess_points))]

stew(
  file = output_model_name_1, 
  dir = output_models_dir,
  expr = {
    start <- Sys.time()
    m_global_1 <- foreach (guess=iter(guess_points, "row"), .combine=c) %dopar% {
      (
        m_1
        %>% mif2(
          Np=Np,
          Nmif=Nmif,
          params=c(fixed_params, unlist(guess)),
          cooling.fraction.50 = 0.5,
          rw.sd = rw.sd
        )
        %>% mif2(cooling.fraction.50 = 0.1)
      )
    }
    loglik_global_1 <- (
      foreach(
        i=1:Nreps,
        .combine=rbind
      ) %dopar% {
        logmeanexp(
          replicate(
            Nreps_eval,
            logLik(pfilter(m_1, params=coef(m_global_1[[i]]), Np=1000))
          ),
          se=TRUE
        )
      }
    )
    end <- Sys.time()
    cat("Run time of global iterated particle filter: ", as.integer(round(difftime(end, start, units='mins'))), " minutes")
  }
)
```

# Benchmarks

## Negative binomial IID Model

```{r}
nb_lik <- function(tau) {
  -sum(
    dnbinom(
      as.vector(obs(m_1)),
      size = exp(tau[1]),
      prob = exp(tau[2]),
      log = TRUE
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
nb_mle <- optim(c(0, -5), nb_lik)
```

```{r}
nb_mle$par
```

```{r}
-nb_mle$value
```

## Negative Binomial AR1

```{r}
arnb <- NegBin$arnb_fit(
  data = as.vector(obs(m_1)),
  start_vals = c(20, 0.5, 1),
)
```

```{r}
arnb$theta
```

```{r}
arnb$ll
```

## ARMA model

```{r}
log_y <- log(as.vector(obs(m_1)) + 1)
arma_fit <- arima(
  log_y,
  order=c(2, 0, 2),
  seasonal=list(
    order=c(1, 0, 1),
    period=1
  )
)
```

```{r}
arma_fit$loglik - sum(log_y)
```

```{r}
arma_fit$coef
```

# Collect results

```{r}
lls <- list(
  loglik_global_b[,1],
  loglik_global_0[,1],
  loglik_global_1[,1],
  loglik_global_2[,1],
  loglik_global_3[,1],
  loglik_global_4[,1],
  loglik_global_5[,1]
)

mech_models <- list(
  m_global_b[[which.max(loglik_global_b[,1])]],
  m_global_0[[which.max(loglik_global_0[,1])]],
  m_global_1[[which.max(loglik_global_1[,1])]],
  m_global_2[[which.max(loglik_global_2[,1])]],
  m_global_3[[which.max(loglik_global_3[,1])]],
  m_global_4[[which.max(loglik_global_4[,1])]],
  m_global_5[[which.max(loglik_global_5[,1])]]
)

model_names <- c(
  "m_b",
  paste0("m_", 0:(length(lls)-2)),
  # "nb_iid",
  "nb_ar1",
  "SARIMA"
)

num_params <- sapply(mech_models, function(x) length(coef(x)) - 5)
num_params <- c(
  num_params, 
  # 2, 
  3, 
  7
)
lls_best <- sapply(lls, max)
lls_best <- c(
  lls_best, 
  # -nb_mle$value, 
  arnb$ll, 
  arma_fit$loglik - sum(log_y)
)
aics <- -2 * lls_best + 2 * num_params
delta_aics <- aics - min(aics)

df_summary <- (
  data.frame(
    Model = model_names,
    Log_Likelihood = round(lls_best),
    Parameter_Number = num_params,
    deltaAIC = round(delta_aics),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
)
```

```{r}
df_summary
```
